# Debian/Ubuntu packages required on Linux CI / release builds.
# These are system .so / toolchain packages — not available as pip wheels.
# Install: sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends $(grep -vE '^\s*#|^\s*$' .github/scripts/apt-linux.txt)
#
# Sources: Qt Linux requirements (xcb QPA), packaging (rpm), build (gcc, pkg-config).
# See https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/linux-requirements.html
